translations.After an <color=#ff6634>800-year civil w:
在人类星际战争的<color=#ff6634>八百年内战</color>之后，我们最终诞生了一支将永远终结所有人类战争的力量：<color=#ff6634>人工智能</color>。

AI 在力量上迅速超越人类，并控制了大部分自动化军队，几乎将人类从银河系表面抹去。<color=#ff6634>只有零星的人类聚居地幸存下来</color>，躲藏在内战和 AI 领导的灭绝行动留下的散落残骸中。

你指挥着最后一支可观的人类军事力量。它如此微小，以至于<color=#ff6634>AI 要么没有察觉，要么根本不在意。</color>

也许是巧合，银河系之外的某种东西似乎远比人类更能分散 AI 的注意力。

你必须壮大你的力量，捕获并重新激活来自旧战争的舰队……但<color=#ff6634>你必须小心</color>不要变得过于强大，以免 AI 的目光重新转向你。

获取足够的力量，捕获足够的舰队，夺回足够的星球，使你能够摧毁被称为 AI 霸主的巨型结构，并在<color=#ff6634>AI 甚至还未完全意识到战争已经开始之前</color>终结这场新的战争。

如果你过于贪婪，如果你让自己变得过于具有威胁性，<color=#ff6634>如果你让 AI 意识到你可能是一个真正的威胁……</color>那我们所有人都将失去一切。

你必须谨慎行事，避免分心和诱惑，像使用手术刀一样运用你的力量。敢于冒险，勇敢果断，但不要试图成为征服者。<color=#ff6634>直击核心。</color>

After an <color=#ff6634>800-year civil war</color> between humans fighting amongst the stars, we finally birthed a force that would end all human wars forever: <color=#ff6634>Artificial Intelligence</color>.

Quickly eclipsing the humans in power and taking control of most of their automated forces, the AI nearly wiped the human race from the face of the galaxy.  <color=#ff6634>Only scattered pockets of humans remain</color>, hiding amidst the scattered wreckage from the civil war and the AI-led extermination that followed.

You are in command of the last substantial remaining human military force.  It is so small that <color=#ff6634>the AI is either unaware of it, or just doesn't care.</color>

Potentially coincidentally, something outside the galaxy seems to have distracted the AI far more than humans ever did.

You must grow your forces, capturing and reactivating fleets from the old wars... but <color=#ff6634>you must be careful</color> not to grow so strong that the eye of the AI turns back toward you.

Gain just enough power, capture just enough fleets, take back just enough planets, that you can destroy the massive structures known as 'AI Overlords' and <color=#ff6634>end this new war before the AI is even fully aware it has begun</color>.

If you are too greedy, if you make yourself too threatening, <color=#ff6634>if you let the AI realize you might be a true threat...</color> expect us all to lose everything.

You must use discretion, avoid distraction and temptation, and wield your forces like a scalpel.  Take risks, be bold, but don't try to be a conquerer. <color=#ff6634>Go for the core.</color>
